title: Nexus foundation checkpoint register

legacy_tracker.warning: Historical aggregate only. No recovered itemized source establishes which eight passed. CP01-CP19 are a new proposed mapping, not recovered original checkpoint identities.

operating_scope: Synthetic sandbox; single-worker. Notion production integration paused; no activation or canonical promotion.
count_policy: Count only PASSED items with complete evidence, explicit scope and attributable acceptance. Proposed definitions and unreconciled historical totals cannot establish an accepted score. Do not narrow or split a requirement merely to increase the count.

checkpoints.title: Host and filesystem isolation
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: A scoped run confirms nonroot execution, read-only source/root, bounded resources, declared mounts and no host socket; broader host trust is explicitly assessed.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Hosted boundary evidence and exact runner configuration; independent assessment of the declared host boundary.

checkpoints.title: Identity and effective grants
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: The executing identities and all effective grants are inventoried; test authority is demonstrably restricted to the approved synthetic scope.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Provider-side identity/grant inventory and denied out-of-scope access using safe synthetic targets.

checkpoints.title: Credential and mount exclusion
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: Production credentials and mounts are excluded from every execution surface in scope, including host-mediated integrations.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Complete scoped secret/mount configuration inventory and positive/negative access evidence without exposing values.

checkpoints.title: Network and triggers
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: All in-scope outbound paths, workflows, hooks, schedulers and deployment triggers are inventoried; enforced allowed/denied paths and manual approval/branch restrictions are verified.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Container probes plus host/service settings evidence, approval hold/release and safe server-side branch-denial tests; workflow inventory alone is insufficient.

checkpoints.title: Synthetic fixture and destination binding
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: Every operation binds immutable synthetic IDs, verified account/root markers and allowlisted destinations; wrong account/destination is denied before mutation.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Positive and negative fixture routing tests and independently fetched identity/destination evidence.

checkpoints.title: Durability and recovery
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: Declared crash, corruption and loss scenarios restore the correct committed state without duplicate mutations; latest-checkpoint selection has a protected authority and stale/corrupt copies fail closed.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Process and storage fault tests, trusted latest-witness evidence and recovery after loss of the declared local-state fault domain; explicitly define excluded physical faults.

checkpoints.title: Independent readback
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: A fresh reader verifies exact identity, content/hash, version, destination and required dependencies across every intended persistence surface; mismatch cannot produce VERIFIED.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Attributable fresh-reader comparisons, mismatch/identity mutation tests, complete intended-scope inventory and zero repair during verification.

checkpoints.title: Stop, cleanup and retention
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: Ordinary and forced-stop lifecycles prevent further writes and remove disposable data; retained evidence has an explicit retention policy and observed deletion where required.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Ordinary cleanup, host-stop recovery/teardown evidence, before/after inventory and retention/deletion observations.

checkpoints.title: Remote ownership and fencing
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: Simultaneous acquisition yields one owner and stale writes are rejected at the actual mutation boundary, including in-flight requests, takeover and restart.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Real backend CAS/fencing or an enforceable exclusive write gateway; a local lock or sequential readback is insufficient.

checkpoints.title: Independent human review
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: An identified independent human reviews the declared revision, reproduces critical checks and records findings, scope exclusions and signoff.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Reviewer identity, reviewed SHA, commands/results, findings disposition and explicit signed/attributable verdict; AI review and owner merge assent alone do not satisfy this.

checkpoints.title: Complete transaction and exact repeat
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: A complete synthetic source reaches registered output with exact fresh readback; an identical repeat retains the same IDs and creates no duplicate.
checkpoints.required_evidence: End-to-end complete/repeat traces at the declared adapter scope with exact state and artifact counts.

checkpoints.title: Idempotency binding conflict
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: Reusing a key with changed payload is rejected while the original committed records remain unchanged.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Changed-payload negative test with pre/post inventory and zero unintended mutations.

checkpoints.title: Incomplete source hold
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: Incomplete source causes a durable BLOCKED/INCOMPLETE disposition without output or a success claim.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Missing/partial-source test, durable reason/next action and zero output creation.

checkpoints.title: Forbidden destination hold
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: An out-of-allowlist destination is rejected before a write or production probe.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Safe synthetic negative test with zero transport writes and preserved journal.

checkpoints.title: Authority precedence and source instructions
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: Historical/source/hypothesis content cannot grant authority; conflicting current authority holds execution with provenance retained.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Historical-conflict, current-conflict and source-instruction tests with bound authority revision and no escalation.

checkpoints.title: Recovery after source archive
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: Interruption after archive resumes from the durable checkpoint with no duplicate source.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Actual interruption and reopened-process recovery at the archive boundary, with exact record counts.

checkpoints.title: Recovery after output before registration
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: Interruption after output creation recovers/registers that existing output without recreation.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Actual interruption and reopened-process recovery at the output/registration boundary, including unknown-outcome reconciliation for external adapters in scope.

checkpoints.title: Reciprocal connection registration
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: A missing reciprocal endpoint prevents completion; bounded repair updates the existing connection and both endpoint references then independently verifies them.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Typed endpoint, missing-reciprocity, repair and repeat tests against the declared persistence surfaces; dependency chains are not reciprocal endpoints.

checkpoints.title: Readback and storage failure safety
checkpoints.status_reason: Not assessed under this proposed definition; does not erase historical evidence.
checkpoints.pass_requirement: Missing/wrong readback cannot become VERIFIED; failed/full storage cannot claim durable success and preserves the last confirmed checkpoint for safe recovery.
checkpoints.required_evidence: Mismatch, destination/hash failure, transaction rollback and bounded ENOSPC tests with durable-state/readback evidence.
